items.title_en: Norway Mourns King Harald as Haakon VIII Ascends the Throne
items.summary_en: King Harald V of Norway, one of Europe's most beloved monarchs, has died in hospital at the age of 89 after being treated for a rare blood condition, and his son has assumed the throne as King Haakon VIII. The palace announced the king's death at 06:35 local time on Friday, beginning an official period of national mourning. Crowds quickly gathered outside the royal palace in Oslo, laying flowers and flags with some mourners visibly in tears, and an estimated 10,000 people lined the capital's streets as the late king's coffin was driven in procession from the national hospital to the palace while the Akershus Fortress fired a 21-gun salute in his honour. The 53-year-old new king held an extraordinary council of state meeting with government ministers, pledging to live up to the royal family motto, "All for Norway". Harald reigned for 35 years and was credited with modernising the monarchy and making it more open and inclusive, having famously broken royal tradition by marrying a commoner, Queen Sonja. European royals including Britain's King Charles III, political leaders and ordinary citizens paid tribute to his service, with Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Store saying the country was "united in grief and gratitude".
items.title_zh: 挪威全國哀悼哈拉爾國王辭世，哈康八世登基接掌王位
items.summary_zh: 歐洲最受愛戴的君主之一、挪威國王哈拉爾五世（King Harald V）在治療罕見血液疾病後於醫院辭世，享齡 89 歲，其子哈康（Haakon）已繼位成為哈康八世國王。王宮於週五當地時間早上六點三十五分宣布國王逝世的消息，挪威隨即展開官方的全國哀悼期。人群迅速湧現奧斯陸王宮外，獻上鮮花與國旗，不少悼念者明顯流下眼淚；據估算約有一萬名民眾夾道肅立，目送先王的靈櫬由國家醫院以車隊護送至王宮，阿克什胡斯城堡並鳴放 21 響禮炮向他致意。現年五十三歲的新王與內閣部長們舉行了特別的國務委員會會議，並誓言恪守王室格言「一切為了挪威」。哈拉爾在位三十五年，被譽為推動君主制現代化、使其更開放包容的君主；他當年與平民出身的桑雅王后結縭，一舉打破王室傳統，傳為佳話。包括英國國王查理三世在內的歐洲王室成員、政治領袖與平民百姓紛紛致上崇高的敬意與追思，首相約納斯加爾史托滕（Jonas Gahr Store）表示，全國此刻「在同悲與感恩之中緊密團結」。

items.title_en: US Judge Rules Trump Administration Illegally Retaliated Against Anthropic
items.summary_en: A US federal judge has ruled that the Trump administration acted unlawfully when it designated the artificial intelligence firm Anthropic a supply chain risk, a label normally reserved for foreign adversaries, in a decision the court called "illegal and baseless". Announced by the Pentagon in February, the designation would have forced companies doing business with the US military to shun the maker of the Claude chatbot, and marked the first time an American company had been publicly designated in this way. Judge Rita Lin wrote that citing national security was "not a blank check to punish and retaliate against government critics", adding in earlier proceedings that the case appeared to be "classic First Amendment retaliation" aimed at crippling the company and chilling public debate. The dispute began when Anthropic refused to allow its AI models to be used for mass surveillance or autonomous weapons, arguing they were not reliable enough to be safely built into weapons systems. The White House had previously dismissed Anthropic as "a radical left, woke company attempting to control military activity", insisting that the military answers to the US Constitution and not to "any woke AI company's terms of service". Anthropic welcomed the ruling, saying it hoped to keep working productively with the government to harness AI for national security so that all Americans benefit from the technology; the BBC contacted the Pentagon and the White House for comment.
items.title_zh: 美國法官裁定川普政府對 Anthropic 的打壓屬違法報復
items.summary_zh: 美國一名聯邦法官裁定，川普政府在將人工智慧公司 Anthropic 認定為「供應鏈風險」時涉有違法；此一標籤通常只適用於外國對手，而法院直言該項決定「違法且毫無根據」。五角大廈於二月宣布的這項認定，原本將迫使所有與美軍有業務往來的企業迴避 Claude 聊天機器人的開發商 Anthropic；這也是美國本土公司首度被公開冠上供應鏈風險的頭銜。法官 Rita Lin 在裁定書中寫道，援引國家安全並非「一張可用來懲罰並報復政府批評者的空白支票」；她在此前的審理中更指出，此案看似「典型違反美國憲法第一修正條文的報復行為」，意圖癱瘓該公司並讓公共辯論寒蟬。這場爭議起因於 Anthropic 拒絕讓美軍將其 AI 模型用於大規模監視或自主武器，並主張模型可靠度不足，若貿然整合進武器系統恐有安全之虞。白宮先前則斥責 Anthropic 是「試圖操縱軍事行動的激進左派『覺醒』公司」（編註：woke，指政治正確的覺醒意識），並強調美軍只向美國憲法負責，而不是聽命於「任何 AI 公司的服務條款」。Anthropic 對裁定表示歡迎，並表示期望持續與政府進行富有成效的合作，讓 AI 技術應用於國家安全、使全體美國人都能從中受益；BBC 已分別聯繫五角大廈與白宮尋求回應。

items.title_en: Haaland and Cherki Fire Impressive Man City to 4-1 Victory at Palace
items.summary_en: Erling Haaland and Rayan Cherki each scored twice as Manchester City cruised to a 4-1 victory over Crystal Palace at Selhurst Park on Friday, keeping manager Enzo Maresca's side's winning start to the Premier League season intact. The French playmaker Cherki dazzled with his touches and dribbling throughout the evening, capping his performance with two goals, while Haaland showed his usual ruthlessness in front of goal to double his tally for the night. Palace's only goal came in unusual fashion when Yeremy Pino's splendid free-kick was recorded as a Donnarumma own goal. Adam Wharton was a class act at the heart of Crystal Palace's midfield with his composure and superb range of passing, but his side were eventually over-run against the visitors' depth of quality. The match also marked Marc Guehi's return to Selhurst Park, where he received a warm welcome from the home fans following his summer move to Manchester City. City's defence, marshalled by Ruben Dias, was rarely troubled, with Donnarumma hardly overworked apart from a crucial early save to deny Eddie Nketiah as Palace briefly threatened.
items.title_zh: 哈蘭與謝爾基各建雙功 曼城 4 比 1 大勝水晶宮
items.summary_zh: 哈蘭（Erling Haaland）與謝爾基（Rayan Cherki）雙雙梅開二度，協助曼徹斯特城週五在塞爾赫斯特公園球場以 4 比 1 大勝水晶宮，讓總教練馬雷斯卡（Enzo Maresca）率隊本賽季在英超的不敗開局得以延續。法國前場核心謝爾基全場以細膩觸球與盤帶屢次閃耀，並攻入兩球為表現畫龍點睛；哈蘭則維持一貫門前的冷靜與殺手本色，也將本晚個人進球數加倍。水晶宮唯一的進球來得頗為特殊：皮諾（Yeremy Pino）開出一記美妙自由球，最終被記錄為曼城門將杜納魯瑪（Donnarumma）的烏龍球。沃頓（Adam Wharton）在水晶宮中場表現堪称典範，沉著的處理球與傳球射程俱屬上乘，但球隊終究不敵曼城板凳深度的品質優勢，逐步被壓過。此役也是葛伊（Marc Guehi）夏季轉會曼城後重返塞爾赫斯特公園的一戰，主場球迷向他獻上熱情洋溢的歡迎。曼城後防由魯本狄亞斯（Ruben Dias）坐鎮，幾乎未遇太大威脅；杜納魯瑪全場大致清閒，唯有開賽初期一次關鍵撲救擋下尼凱緹亞（Eddie Nketiah），化解水晶宮短暫的反撲。
